descriptor: Hiking boots with honest customer reviews

voice.summary: Sounds like a trail shop owner reading real reviews aloud: even-handed, specific about fit and grip. Praise and complaints get the same weight.
dos: Quote reviewers on fit, grip and comfort
Respond to criticism with a fix
donts: No gear jargon for its own sake

taglines: Boots reviewed by the people wearing them
boilerplate: Ridgeline Trail Boots makes hard-wearing hiking boots and publishes every customer review, including the critical ones, with ratings you can filter by keyword.
